definitions: A type of wine that incorporates some of the color from the grape skins, but not enough to qualify it as a red wine. It can be the oldest known type of wine, with the production of red wine being more recent.
A wine made from red grapes by a process in which the skins are allowed to remain in contact with the must for only a short period, typically one to three days, to give the wine a pink color.
examples: We ordered a bottle of rose wine with dinner.
Rose wine pairs well with many dishes.
The vineyard is known for its excellent rose wine.
